newsitem.title: USA: Florida suicide victim on tape making bomb - police.
newsitem.headline: Florida suicide victim on tape making bomb - police.

text.p: Police evacuated an apartment complex for four hours Monday after finding the decomposing body of a suicide victim and a videotape of the man making a bomb.

Investigators went to the apartment of Ricardo Lopez, 21, when the manager of the building complained of a foul odour and found his body on the floor, said Hollywood Police Department spokeswoman Stephanie Norris.
"There were indications that he had killed himself several days earlier," Norris said but did not specify how.
During their investigation, police found a videotape in the man's VCR and watched it, Norris said.
"Mr. Lopez is on the tape constructing what looks like an explosive device," she said.

Police evacuated about 75 people from the apartment complex and surrounding businesses while they searched the man's apartment. They found "questionable material" and confiscated it, but no explosive device was discovered, Norris said.
Investigators would not discuss the nature of the material they confiscated, she said.
